servers.title: Your servers
servers.subtitle: Pick one to manage, or create another.
servers.deleteText: It disappears from MineHost, but the folder and your world stay on disk.
servers.emptyHint: Create your first one; it only takes a couple of minutes.
panel.title: Dashboard
panel.subtitle: Start the server and share the address.
panel.setupText: It will be running in a couple of minutes. MineHost downloads everything it needs, Java included.
panel.addressHintTunnel: The address changes each time the tunnel restarts (ngrok free plan).
panel.addressHintStart: Start the server to get the address.
panel.addressHintToken: Add your ngrok authtoken in Settings, Remote access.
panel.addressHintForward: Your friends connect here once you forward the port on your router.
panel.addressHintLan: Only reachable from your own network.
world.title: World
world.subtitle: Your worlds, game rules and datapacks.
world.emptyHint: It gets created the first time you start the server.
world.rulesNotice: Game rules apply while the server is running.
world.noDatapacksHint: Datapacks add recipes, structures or mechanics without mods.
world.deleteText: {name} is moved to a recycle folder inside the server, just in case.
mods.title: Mods
mods.subtitle: Your friends need the same mods to join.
mods.subtitlePlugins: Your friends do not need to install anything.
mods.emptyHint: Drag JAR files in, or search Modrinth.
mods.vanillaHint: Switch to NeoForge, Fabric or Paper in Settings to add them.
mods.noServerHint: Install a server before adding mods.
mods.clientOnlyHint: This mod does nothing on a server.
mods.noResultsHint: Nothing compatible with {version} for this platform.
mods.searchFirstHint: I need the version and platform to find compatible content.
mods.deleteText: {name} will be removed from the server folder.
players.title: Players
players.subtitle: Operators, whitelist and bans.
players.hintWhitelist: With the whitelist on, only these players can join.
players.emptyOps: Add your own name so you can use commands in game.
players.emptyOther: Add players with the field above.
backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Save your world before something goes wrong.
backups.emptyHint: Make one before installing mods or changing the world.
backups.restoreText: Your current world is set aside before being replaced. The server must be stopped.
backups.deleteText: This backup will be removed for good.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Server, memory, access and game options.
settings.name: Server name
settings.folderHint: The world, mods and backups live here.
settings.reinstallText: The server files are downloaded again. Your world and mods are untouched.
settings.memoryHint: Your machine has {total} GB. 6-8 GB is plenty even with many mods.
settings.memoryWarn: Your machine has {total} GB. Leaving under 2 GB free can slow Windows down.
settings.autoRestartHint: Starts again on its own after an unexpected shutdown.
settings.restartIntro: A daily restart frees memory and keeps the server smooth. Players get a warning in chat first.
access.title: How your friends connect
access.intro: Choose how people reach your PC. You can change this at any time.
access.tunnelBlurb: Works without touching the router. Ideal if you cannot or would rather not configure it.
access.forwardBlurb: Direct connection and better latency, but you need access to the router.
access.lanBlurb: Just for people in your own home. Nothing to configure.
access.step1Hint: You need to verify a card; ngrok charges nothing on the free plan.
access.step2Hint: It is in the dashboard, under Your Authtoken.
access.forwardStep1: Give this PC a fixed IP
access.forwardStep1Hint: In your router, reserve {ip} for this computer so it does not change.
access.forwardStep2: Open the port on the router
access.forwardStep2Hint: Forward port {port} (TCP) to {ip}. Look for Port Forwarding or Virtual Server.
access.forwardStep3Hint: MineHost can add the rule for you; it needs administrator permission.
access.forwardStep4Hint: This is what your friends type in Minecraft.
access.forwardOpen: Port {port} is open. Your friends can connect.
access.forwardClosed: Port {port} is not reachable from outside. Check the router rule.
access.forwardNeedsRunning: Start the server before testing the port.
access.forwardCgnat: Your provider appears to use CGNAT, so port forwarding will not work. Use the tunnel instead.
access.firewallFailed: Could not add the rule. You can add it by hand in Windows Firewall.
access.lanIntro: Anyone on your own network can join with the address below. Nothing else to set up.
console.title: Console
console.subtitle: Everything happening on the server, live.
wizard.nameTitle: What do you want to call it?
wizard.nameText: A name to recognise it by. You can change it later.
wizard.folderTitle: Where should we put the server?
wizard.folderText: Pick an empty folder. The world, mods and backups will live there.
wizard.platformTitle: What kind of server do you want?
wizard.platformText: You can change this later in Settings.
wizard.versionText: Everyone joining must use exactly this version.
wizard.accessText: This changes what MineHost sets up for you. You can switch later.
wizard.needName: Give it a name to continue.
tour.powerText: This starts and stops it. The first run takes a little longer while the world is generated.
tour.addressText: Once the server is running, the address for your friends shows up here. You join with localhost.
tour.tunnelText: To let friends join from another house you need an ngrok authtoken. It is free and takes two minutes.
tour.forwardText: You chose port forwarding. Here are the exact steps for your router, and a button to test that it works.
tour.lanText: You chose local network only. Anyone in your home can join with the address on the dashboard.
tour.backupText: Before installing mods or changing the world, save a copy. One click restores it.
tour.serversText: You can keep several here and switch between them whenever you like.
common.savedRestart: Saved. Restart the server to apply.
common.versionsFailed: Could not load the version list.
versions.betaHint: Betas are unfinished and may break your world. Only pick one if a mod needs it.
events.title: Activity
events.subtitle: The moments that matter, as they happen.
events.emptyHint: Joins, deaths, advancements and nights slept show up here while the server runs.
files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Browse the server folder and edit its config files.
files.saved: File saved. A .bak copy of the previous version was kept.
files.emptyHint: Drop files here to add them.
files.deleteText: {name} is moved to a recycle folder inside the server, not erased.
files.tooBig: This file is too large to edit here.
files.notEditable: This file cannot be edited as text.
files.exists: Something with that name already exists.
settings.trayHint: Closing the window leaves the server up, reachable from the clock area.
settings.autoLaunchHint: Opens minimised in the tray when you log in.
wake.hint: While the server sleeps MineHost holds the port. The first person to join wakes it and gets a message asking them to reconnect.
wake.sleeping: Sleeping · join to wake it up
wake.starting: Starting up, give it a moment
wake.waking: Waking the server up. Reconnect in about a minute.
perf.title: Performance
perf.subtitle: How the server is holding up.
perf.tpsHint: 20 is perfect. Below 15 the game feels sluggish.
perf.unknownHint: This platform does not report tick rate.
perf.emptyHint: Start the server and the readings will appear here.
err.NGROK_MISSING: ngrok is not installed yet. MineHost will download it; check your connection and try again.
err.NGROK_BLOCKED: Windows blocked ngrok.exe. Allow it in your antivirus and try again.
err.NGROK_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: ngrok could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
err.NGROK_FAILED: ngrok did not accept that authtoken. Copy it again from the dashboard.
err.NOT_INSTALLED: This server is not installed yet.
err.NGROK_QUARANTINED: Your antivirus removed ngrok.exe. It is a false alarm: tunnelling tools get flagged because malware abuses them too.
access.defenderDone: Exception added. Try saving the authtoken again.
err.DEFENDER_DENIED: The permission prompt was declined, so the exception was not added.
err.DEFENDER_FAILED: The exception could not be added. You can add it by hand in Windows Security.
